:::{#thm-exposure-log-scale}
#### Exposure is additive on the log scale

If $\mean = \rate\cdot t$ with $\rate > 0$ and $t > 0$, then:

$$\log{\mean} = \log{\rate} + \log{t}$$

:::

::: proof
$$
\ba
\log{\mean}
&= \log(\rate \cdot t) && (\text{substitute } \mean = \rate \cdot t) \\
&= \log{\rate} + \log{t} && (\text{logarithm product rule})
\ea
$$
:::
